theater: 特里平原與庫馬翁山區

battle.name: 廓爾喀戰爭
battle.theater: 特里平原與庫馬翁山區
battle.brief: 一八一四年十一月，尼泊爾廓爾喀王國越過特里平原，侵入東印度公司的庫馬翁與加爾瓦爾。馬德拉斯與加爾各答兩路部隊在納拉帕尼狹路交火，羅洛·吉列斯皮上校陣亡，英軍崩退。翌年英軍沿山道反攻，在阿爾查爾雪夜頂住廓爾喀的突襲，一八一六年迫使尼泊爾割地賠款。長槍在此僅餘象徵性的近戰兵器地位。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 一八一四年開打的是尼泊爾廓爾喀王國與英屬印度東印度公司之爭，形式上是邊界糾紛，實質是喜馬拉雅山南麓控制權與商路稅權的爭奪。進攻方是尼泊爾：國王吉爾萬·尤德哈·比克拉姆·沙阿登基不久，攝政與首相席位由巴哈杜爾·沙阿留下的一批老臣掌握，軍權則集中在以阿馬爾·比爾·塔帕為代表的軍事家族手中；兵源來自廓爾喀與尼泊爾山區的村社民兵，按地方「庫迪」小隊編組，裝備以火繩槍為主，能用的火炮只是數門小型旋轉炮。防守方是東印度公司：加爾各答總督轄下的孟加拉部隊與馬德拉斯總督轄下的馬德拉斯部隊各成一路，公司不承認尼泊爾對庫馬翁的佔領，也拒絕讓山區門戶保持名義上的開放；英軍由英籍軍官率領印度「土兵」步兵，輔以英屬印度的標準連屬野戰炮，後方設有軍需總監、醫院與不斷延伸的補給站。值得強調的是雙方體制的懸殊：尼泊爾以宮廷與軍事家族為核心，命令與糧秣靠山道口耳相傳；英軍有近代化的指揮、參謀、軍需與郵遞制度，卻分屬加爾各答與馬德拉斯兩處總督各自節制，戰場指揮官多半只是執行總督府訓令的戰役指揮。第三方面是山地部落與地方勢力：廓爾喀人在許多村社得到主動嚮導與嚮導人，英軍則必須靠傭兵、向導與慣常的酬金換取通行，並不斷為「友軍引路」付出代價。
countriesEn: What broke out in 1814 was a war between the Gurkha Kingdom of Nepal and the British East India Company in India: formally a boundary quarrel, in substance a contest over control of the southern slopes of the Himalaya and over the customs revenue of the trade routes. The attacking side was Nepal. King Girvan Yuddha Bikram Shah had only just taken the throne, the regency and the premiership were held by the old ministers left behind by Bahadur Shah, and real military power lay with the armed families represented by Amar Bir Thapa. The troops came from the village militias of the Gurkha and Nepali hills, organised in local kudi companies, armed mainly with matchlock muskets, with only a few small swivel guns for artillery. The defending side was the East India Company: a Bengal force from Calcutta and a Madras force from the Madras presidency, each an independent line. The Company refused to recognise Nepal's occupation of Kumaon and refused to leave the hill passes formally open. Its army was Indian sepoy infantry under British officers, with the Company's standard brigade and regimental smoothbore field guns, and behind them a commissariat, hospitals and a supply line that grew longer with every month. What deserves emphasis is the asymmetry of the two systems. Nepal's was centred on the court and the military families, with orders and grain passed from mouth to mouth along the mountain paths. The British had modern command, staff, supply and postal arrangements, yet they were split between two presidencies, each with its own governor-general, and the battlefield commanders were mostly executors of instructions sent down from those governors. A third party was the mountain communities and local powers: the Gurkhas found active guides and shelter in many villages, while the British had to hire interpreters, guides and local escorts, and paid the customary price for being guided at every stage.
people: 廓爾喀方面的關鍵人物是阿馬爾·比爾·塔帕。他是尼泊爾最傑出的將領，一八一四年越境作戰的主帥，曾自塔讓坡出奇兵攻入加爾瓦爾，在納拉帕尼把英軍打得節節敗退；一八一五年在攻打阿爾莫拉一帶時中箭身亡，英軍得以深入山區的戰局隨之改觀，其子阿馬爾·辛格接任統帥。英方加爾各答方面的指揮中樞是陸軍中將大衛·奧克特洛尼，他一八一四年十二月接替陣亡的吉列斯皮上校負責北部戰區，改採穩紮穩打、逐點攻取的山道戰術，最終奪下阿爾莫拉與阿爾查爾一帶的高地，再沿索提河谷與加爾瓦爾境內要塞推進，於一八一六年進抵加德滿都外圍。陣亡的羅洛·吉列斯皮上校是英軍在納拉帕尼的戰役指揮，他以兩千餘人的分遣隊硬擋數千廓爾喀步兵於狹窄山口，扭轉第一日戰局，但自己率騎兵衝鋒時中彈身亡，餘部隨即在第二日遭伏擊潰散。馬德拉斯方面由少將喬治·托馬斯率領果阿出發的印度步兵與炮兵北上，牽制了廓爾喀主力，使英軍得以兩面同時施壓。地方人物方面，尼泊爾宮廷在戰局失利後分成兩派：老臣主張議和，比姆森·塔帕等則主張繼續抵抗；最後由國王以裁決收場，批准割地條約。還有一項常被忽略的人力因素：不少曾在邁索爾蘇丹蒂普軍中服役的尼泊爾人與廓爾喀逃亡者，在兩軍之間流轉，雙方都吸納這些熟悉歐洲火器的山地老兵。
peopleEn: The key Gurkha figure was Amar Bir Thapa, the ablest of Nepal's commanders and the leader of the invasion of 1814. He turned the campaign with a surprise thrust from the Torang Khu side into Garhwal and cut the British up piecemeal at Nalapani; he was wounded by an arrow during the operations against Almora in 1815, and the campaign picture changed after his death, his son Amar Singh taking over. On the British side the command centre in Calcutta was Lieutenant-General David Ochterlony, who took over the northern theatre in December 1814 after the death of Gillespie and switched to a methodical advance along the hill roads, point by point, ending with the capture of Almora and the heights around Archal, and then pushing down the Soti valley and the strongholds of Garhwal to the outskirts of Kathmandu in 1816. The fallen Rollo Gillespie was the British battle commander at Nalapani: with some two thousand men he held a narrow defile against several thousand Gurkha foot and turned the first day's action, then was killed leading a mounted charge, and his command was broken by an ambush the following day. On the Madras side Lieutenant-General George Thomas led Indian infantry and guns north from Goa, tying down Gurkha strength and allowing the British to press on two axes at once. Among the local figures, the Nepalese court split into two parties once the position turned: the older ministers pressed for a negotiated peace while Bhimsen Thapa and others wanted to continue resistance; the king finally arbitrated and approved the cession. One factor that is often overlooked is a matter of manpower: a number of Nepalis and Gurkha deserters who had served in the army of Tipu Sahib of Mysore moved back and forth between the two sides, and each army took in these experienced hill men who already knew European firearms.
kits: 長槍在這場戰爭裡幾乎只剩下符號功能。歐洲式火槍方陣在十七世紀末已把長槍擠出射擊序列，英軍的長槍兵團在十八世紀中葉就已廢除，到一八一四年的英屬印度步兵，連線的骨幹是平滑膛燧發火槍與刺刀，長槍僅以士官與執旗者的桿兵器形式留在編制末端，作為軍紀與指揮的標記；真正與它同源的近戰兵器，是廓爾喀人手中的曲刀「庫克里」與長矛，那才是這場戰爭裡的「方陣長槍」。作戰裝備方面，英軍計有步兵的燧發滑膛槍與刺刀、少量獵槍、供士官與傳令兵使用的卡賓槍與馬槍、六磅與九磅滑膛野戰炮、十二磅攻城炮，以及一八一四年前後已在印度軍中使用、可對密集坡面作齊射支援的康格里夫火箭。廓爾喀方面以火繩槍為主，配少量銅製小炮與架設式旋轉炮，近戰全靠曲刀、長矛與圓盾；山地運載只能靠人背與牛羊馱運，谷地與雪線以下的道路才可通行車輛。真正左右戰局的裝備是補給：英軍靠自加爾各答經阿薩姆、沿喜馬拉雅缺口運來的糧秣、藥品與信件維持縱深作戰；廓爾喀一方的山道運輸只靠人背與牲口，任何一場失敗都會直接斷掉下一場戰鬥的糧食。
kitsEn: The pike in this war survives only as a sign. The European firearm formation had already pushed the pike out of the firing line by the end of the seventeenth century, the British pike regiment was abolished in the middle of the eighteenth, and by 1814 the backbone of the Company infantry was the smoothbore flintlock musket and the bayonet, with the pike left at the far end of the order of battle as a polearm of sergeants and standard-bearers, a marker of discipline and command. The genuinely analogous close-combat weapons were on the other side: the Gurkha kukri and the long spear, which in this war performed exactly the function the pike had performed in the square. As for the fighting equipment of the British, there were flintlock smoothbore muskets with bayonets, a few hunting rifles, carbines and horse pistols for sergeants and messengers, six- and nine-pounder smoothbore field guns, twelve-pounder siege pieces, and the Congreve rockets already in Indian service by 1814, capable of salvo fire against a crowded hillside. The Gurkhas fought with matchlock muskets, a few small brass guns and mounted swivel pieces, and did their close work with kukri, spear and round shield. In the mountains, movement was entirely on human back and on bullock and yak; only the valleys and the roads below the snow line could take carts. The equipment that truly decided the campaign was supply: the British drew grain, medicine and letters from Calcutta by way of Assam and the Himalayan gaps, and that is what sustained a war fought in depth, whereas the Gurkha mountain logistics rested on porters and pack animals, so any single defeat cut the food of the next battle.
tactics: 廓爾喀方面的戰術核心是地形與高度。廓爾喀步兵進攻時先散成鬆散隊形，攀上兩側山脊佔據石堆與樹叢，然後在狹窄的谷底與山徑上以長矛與火繩槍層層攔截，使英軍的射擊優勢難以展開；英軍在納拉帕尼第一日就吃過這苦頭：地形把炮兵壓在後方，步槍無法同時瞄準上下兩個坡面，一支縱隊在谷底被切成幾段。英軍這邊的戰術則是歐洲式的縱隊與正面火力：先以六磅、九磅炮在狹窄正面建立火網，再由英印步兵以射擊與刺刀交替壓上，配合火箭齊射；吉列斯皮陣亡後，奧克特洛尼改成先築工事再逐步推進的路線戰術，沿山道逐點清剿，每佔一處便設哨所與給養站，減少在狹路中被包圍的風險。一八一五年三月阿爾查爾之戰最能說明兩種戰法的碰撞：英軍在雪線以上的高地築起營壘，廓爾喀軍在雪夜沿陡坡突襲，先用火繩槍與長矛近身，再放火燒英軍帳篷與草料；英軍靠刺刀、齊射與更狹窄的射界頂住了這波攻勢。此後廓爾喀軍轉入遊擊式的破壞，切斷道路與消息，靠冬季封山遲滯英軍，最終把局勢逼到議和。
tacticsEn: The core of Gurkha method was terrain and height. Before attacking, the Gurkha foot would spread out loosely, climb the ridges on either side to occupy screes and scrub, and then block the narrow valley floor and the paths in successive layers with spear and matchlock, so that the British advantage in fire could not be brought to bear. The British learned this at Nalapani on the first day: the ground forced the guns to the rear, the muskets could not aim at both slopes at once, and a column in the valley was cut into sections. The British replied with the European column and frontal fire: first the six- and nine-pounders established a fire net across the narrow front, then Company infantry advanced with alternating fire and bayonet, supported by rocket salvos. After Gillespie's death Ochterlony changed to a road-by-road advance with entrenchments: clear each post, dig in, set up a picket and a supply point, and take the next. The collision of the two methods is clearest at Archal in March 1815. The British built a camp above the snow line; the Gurkhas attacked up the steep slope by night, closing with matchlock and spear and setting fire to the tents and forage; the British held with bayonets, disciplined volleys and a narrower field of fire. Thereafter the Gurkhas turned to raiding, cutting roads and messages and using the winter closure of the passes to slow the British, until the position forced the talks that ended the war.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。一八一四年十一月廓爾喀越境時，能調動的兵力在兩萬上下，不同估計由一萬餘至數萬不等，武器以火繩槍為主；英方第一批投入的部隊約兩千人上下，其中馬德拉斯與加爾各答的步兵各佔一部分，配六磅與九磅野戰炮數門。第一場納拉帕尼之戰在一八一四年十一月二十日於雨中進行，廓爾喀軍在石堆與高地占盡地利，英軍以正面火力和刺刀反擊成功，廓爾喀軍死傷數百後退回山上，陣亡的英方指揮官吉列斯皮上校是這場戰鬥少數有明確確認的傷亡記錄。十二月的第二場納拉帕尼之戰，廓爾喀軍切斷退路、居高臨下射擊，英軍傷亡與被俘約一千五百至二千人，殘部退向加爾各答方向。此後英軍兵力逐次增加，至一八一六年深入尼泊爾境內時，公司方面投入的部隊已達數萬之譜，廓爾喀方面則因戰線拉長與糧秣短缺而大減。條約條件是割讓庫馬翁、加爾瓦爾與錫金，支付賠款約二百萬盧比，各史料的數目略有出入，並同意在加德滿都接受英國常駐代表。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. At the crossing in November 1814 the Gurkhas could bring together something like twenty thousand men, estimates ranging from a little over ten thousand to several tens of thousands, armed mainly with matchlocks; the first British force committed was of the order of two thousand men, drawn from both the Madras and Calcutta lines, with a handful of six- and nine-pounder field guns. The first battle of Nalapani was fought on 20 November 1814 in rain. The Gurkhas held the screes and the heights, the British replied with frontal fire and the bayonet, and the Gurkha losses ran to several hundred before they withdrew up the hill; the death of the British commander Gillespie is one of the few confirmed casualty records of the action. In the second battle of Nalapani in December the Gurkhas cut the road behind the British and fired from the heights; British losses, killed and captured, came to some fifteen hundred to two thousand men, and the remnants fell back toward Calcutta. The British force grew steadily thereafter, and by the time the columns were deep inside Nepal in 1816 the Company had committed several tens of thousands of men, while the Gurkhas were worn down by over-extension and want of food. The terms were the cession of Kumaon, Garhwal and Sikkim, an indemnity of about two million rupees, with the figures varying slightly between sources, and the acceptance of a permanent British resident at Kathmandu.
cause: 打起來的直接原因，是山南勢力與山北政權對同一塊地盤的主權認定根本對立。尼泊爾在室利·婆闍·沙阿與巴哈杜爾·沙阿兩代完成中央集權之後，通往印度的商路、山區邊民的貢賦與關稅都急迫需要打通；東印度公司則在一八〇一年之後把庫馬翁收編為自己的土邦，把加爾瓦爾的幾個小土邦置於自己的保護之下，理由是早年與尼泊爾的交涉中已取得名義上的管轄權。公司把這套安排視為既成事實，尼泊爾朝廷則視之為對山南勢力的連根拔除，國庫收入的損失直接壓在巴哈杜爾·沙阿留下的老臣心裡。導火索是一八一四年公司在北印度重新丈量土地、要求地方官員和山區門戶承認英國主權，並試圖在通商、通婚與物資進出上限制尼泊爾商人的活動。尼泊爾判定這是對其山南存在的侵犯，遂於同年秋天集兵越境。公司在數次外交交涉落空之後，選擇以現成的印度部隊收回庫馬翁，也就同時開啟了對尼泊爾本土的戰爭。遠因則包括一七九〇年代公司插手尼泊爾內政、扶植與打壓不同攝政，以及一八〇二至一八一二年間廓爾喀在西藏方向與印度邊境的一連串擴張——雙方的界線從未真正劃定，這場戰爭只是把它們用血畫了出來。
causeEn: The immediate cause was that the mountain state and the power below it held irreconcilable views of who owned the same ground. After the centralising work of the reigns of Prithvi Narayan Shah and Bahadur Shah, the Nepalese state badly needed the trade routes, the tribute and the customs of the southern border opened up; the East India Company had meanwhile taken Kumaon into its own system in 1801 and placed the small states of Garhwal under its protection, on the ground that nominal jurisdiction had been secured in earlier negotiations with Nepal. The Company regarded that arrangement as accomplished fact. The Nepalese court read it as the uprooting of its southern presence, with the loss of customs revenue falling directly on the ministers left over from Bahadur Shah. The trigger was the company's resurvey of land in northern India in 1814, its demand that local officials and the hill passes acknowledge British sovereignty, and its attempt to restrict the movement of Nepalese merchants in trade, in marriages and in the movement of goods. The Gurkhas judged this an attack on their southern existence, and crossed the border with an army in the autumn of that year. When diplomacy failed several times over, the Company chose to retake Kumaon with the Indian troops it already had, and so opened a war on Nepalese soil at the same moment. Deeper causes include the Company's interference in Nepalese internal politics in the 1790s, alternately backing and destroying rival regencies, and the string of Gurkha expansions towards Tibet and the Indian frontier between 1802 and 1812: the boundary between the two states had never actually been drawn, and this war drew it in blood.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果是喜馬拉雅山南麓的版圖被重畫，而重畫的方式對其後兩個半世紀都有影響。尼泊爾割讓庫馬翁、加爾瓦爾與錫金之後，其南部邊界退到山脊線上，往後數十年只能靠加德滿都與山南的零星據點維持對南亞商路的影響，主權伸展的方向被迫轉向西藏與西尼泊爾，而這條路在一八五〇年代又把它拉入中英衝突。東印度公司則得到一條自加爾各答直抵喜馬拉雅山口的完整補給通道，一八三九年第一次阿富汗戰爭正是沿同一條線深入，後來英屬印度每一次向西北的推進都要重複這條補給線的考驗。此戰同時是英國在亞洲以小軍作戰的一次示範：以數千兵力對上數萬，以火槍炮對上火繩槍與地形，最終靠後勤與耐心的加法取勝，確立了東印度公司步步為營、逐點清剿的戰爭模式，也示範了以縱深作戰對付缺少後勤的對手是多麼有效。對廓爾喀人自身，這是一堂關於補給與縱深的課：以曲刀與長矛為核心的山地部隊可以在雪夜進攻中重創英軍，卻無法在一個有近代後勤的帝國面前靠消耗取勝。長遠看還有一層外交制度的影響：尼泊爾接受英國常駐代表，等於在喜馬拉雅南麓打開了第一個常設的歐洲外交據點，此後的英尼關係、中英在邊疆的角力，以及十九世紀末英屬印度的北上政策，都以一八一六年的這份條約為起點。
impactEn: The result of the war was a redrawing of the map of the southern Himalaya, and the manner of that redrawing mattered for the two and a half centuries that followed. After the cession of Kumaon, Garhwal and Sikkim, Nepal's southern frontier was pushed back to the watershed; for decades afterwards it could hold its influence over the southern trade routes only through Kathmandu and a few foothill posts, and its expansion had to turn westward towards Tibet and western Nepal — a road that, in the 1850s, pulled it into the Sino-British conflict. The East India Company, for its part, acquired an unbroken supply road from Calcutta to the Himalayan passes. The First Anglo-Afghan War of 1839 marched up exactly that line, and every later British advance in the north-west had to face the same test of that line. The campaign was also a demonstration of how a small army fought in Asia: a few thousand men against tens of thousands, muskets and cannon against matchlocks and terrain, won by the arithmetic of supply and patience. It established the Company's method of step-by-step clearing and it showed how decisive depth was against an opponent who had none. For the Gurkhas themselves it was a lesson in supply and reach: a hill force built on the kukri and the spear could maul the British in a night attack on the snow, but it could not grind out a war against an empire with modern logistics. In the longer diplomatic line, Nepal's acceptance of a permanent British resident opened the first standing European diplomatic post in the southern Himalaya, and every later development — Anglo-Nepalese relations, the Sino-British rivalry along the frontier, and British India's northern policy in the late nineteenth century — starts from that treaty of 1816.
result: 一八一四年十一月至一八一六年三月，戰爭以廓爾喀方面求和告終。英軍在納拉帕尼損失慘重之後改用穩紮穩打的辦法：先以步步為營奪取特里平原上的幾個關口，再於一八一五年冬春沿阿爾莫拉與加爾瓦爾的山道攻入雪線以上，逐個攻下阿爾查爾、索提河谷與其他要塞，翌年又藉談判的間隙把軍隊推至加德滿都地區。最後由比姆森·塔帕等主張抵抗的一派被清除，國王吉爾萬·尤德哈·比克拉姆·沙阿批准條約，一八一五年十二月二日簽訂蘇加利條約，一八一六年三月在加德滿都換文批准：割讓庫馬翁、加爾瓦爾與錫金，支付賠款，接受英國常駐代表。軍事的結果是英屬印度在北部邊疆取得一條完整的行軍走廊，廓爾喀的山地部隊退守內陸山區；被英軍在戰場上打垮的，是廓爾喀在印度河谷與雪線以上的老練山地步兵，以及它背後那套以宮廷家族為核心、靠山道傳遞命令的體系。在戰術層面上，廓爾喀雪夜突襲的戰果與它最終失敗的命運同樣被記錄下來，成為東印度公司軍在未來二十年裡用來訓練與嚇阻山地對手的教材。
resultEn: From November 1814 to March 1816 the war ended in a Gurkha request for terms. After the mauling at Nalapani the British changed to a methodical method: they took the passes on the Terai plain by successive entrenched positions, then in the winter and spring of 1815 marched up the roads to Almora and Garhwal above the snow line, capturing Archal, the Soti valley and other strongholds one by one, and in the following year pressed into the Kathmandu region while talks were in progress. In the end the party of Bhimsen Thapa, which wanted to continue resistance, was removed. King Girvan Yuddha Bikram Shah approved the terms: the Treaty of Sugauli was signed on 2 December 1815 and ratified at Kathmandu in March 1816, ceding Kumaon, Garhwal and Sikkim, paying the indemnity and accepting a permanent British resident. Militarily the result was a complete line of march secured for British India on the northern frontier, and the Gurkha hill troops driven back into the interior mountains. What the British broke on the field was the Gurkha hill infantry in the valleys of the Terai and above the snow line, and the system behind it: a court-centred machine of military families that passed its orders along the mountain paths. At the tactical level, both the Gurkha night attack on the snow and the final defeat were carefully recorded, and became the training material the Company army used for the next twenty years to prepare for and deter opponents in the hills.
